Conversation Timeline · 对话时间归档

Organize Google Antigravity conversations into collapsible Year / Month / Day folders with an interactive monthly heat calendar and one-click session switching.
将 Antigravity 堆积在一起的历史对话按「年 / 月 / 日」文件夹与月度日历清晰归档，点击即可一键切换会话。

--- ## Why Conversation Timeline? / 为什么做这个插件？ In Antigravity 2.0, hundreds of conversations across weeks and months stack together in a single flat list under each project—making it painful to locate what you discussed on a specific day (and auto-generated English titles often obscure original Chinese prompts). **Conversation Timeline** uses Antigravity's official **Sidecar Web UI Extension (`SIDECAR_UI_ENTRYPOINT_AUX_PANE`)** API to bring a Finder-style chronological folder tree right into your Side Panel—with **zero host patching** and **100% local read-only indexing**. Antigravity 2.0 原生左侧栏把所有日期的对话扁平堆叠在一起，时间一长很难按日期翻找，且中文提问常被自动翻译成英文标题。本插件完全基于官方原生 **Side Panel UI 插件接口**构建，不篡改任何宿主文件，开箱即用。 --- ## Features / 核心特性 - **Collapsible `Year / Month / Day` Folder Tree（年 / 月 / 日 文件夹树）** — Expand `2026年` → `11月` → `11月11日` like Finder, or toggle to a compact `Year / Month` two-level tree in one click. - **Interactive Monthly Heat Calendar（月度热力日历）** — See daily conversation counts at a glance; click any date (e.g. `11`) to filter down to that day, and click again to return to the full tree. - **One-Click Native Switching（一键切换对话）** — Calls `window.sidecar.ui.toggleConversation(id)` to jump straight to any past session, highlighting your active session automatically. - **Native Sidebar Titles + One-Click English ⇄ Chinese Translation（保留原生标题 + 一键中英互译 `译中文`）** — Displays Antigravity's exact native conversation titles (instead of raw prompts), with a one-click **`译中文` / `看原文`** toggle and per-row **`译`** button backed by **Microsoft Azure Translator v3.0 (`F0` Free 2M chars/mo)** + zero-config free fallback and permanent local disk cache. - **Starred Folder (`★`), Custom Aliases (`✎`), Search & Multi-Project Filter（收藏置顶、备注改名、双语检索与项目过滤）** — Pin important threads, set custom aliases, switch between **Created Date (发起日)** and **Last Updated (活跃日)**, and search across both original English titles and translated Chinese titles. - **Zero Dependencies & Sub-Millisecond Incremental Cache（零第三方依赖、极速增量索引）** — Reads only bounded head/tail chunks of `transcript.jsonl` so hundreds of conversations load instantaneously. --- ## Installation / 安装方法 ### Option 1: Antigravity CLI (Recommended / 推荐) ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/Wriquet/conversation-timeline ``` ### Option 2: Git Clone into Global Plugins Directory **macOS / Linux:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/Wriquet/conversation-timeline.git \ ~/.gemini/config/plugins/conversation-timeline ``` **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Wriquet/conversation-timeline.git ` "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\conversation-timeline" ``` --- ## Usage & Docking Tip / 使用与常驻技巧 1. Open **Customizations → Installed** in Antigravity and make sure **Conversation Timeline** is enabled. 2. Open the panel via any of: - Conversation top-right **Overview → Extensions → Conversation Timeline** - Side Panel `+` (New Tab) - Typing `/conversation-timeline` in chat to get a one-click open pill 3. **Pro Tip — Dock It Permanently（常驻侧边栏技巧）**: Right-click the **Conversation Timeline** tab header in the Side Panel and choose **`Pin Tab`（固定标签页）** so your chronological folder tree stays docked across sessions. --- ## Privacy & Security / 隐私与安全边界 - **Local-First & Strict CSP**: Reads Antigravity's local conversation metadata/annotations and `transcript.jsonl` read-only, with strict browser CSP (`connect-src 'self'`). External requests occur **only** when you click **`译中文`** to translate English titles (via Microsoft Azure Translator or the public translation endpoint), and results are cached locally on disk so subsequent toggles are 100% offline. - **Strictly Non-Intrusive**: Never modifies conversation transcripts, `config.json`, or Electron application bundles. Stars, custom title aliases, and UI preferences are stored exclusively inside the plugin's own sandboxed `ANTIGRAVITY_EXECUTABLE_DATA_DIR`. --- ## Project Structure / 目录结构 ```text conversation-timeline/ ├── plugin.json # Official Antigravity plugin manifest ├── assets/ │ ├── logo.svg # 1:1 light/dark adaptive plugin icon │ └── preview.svg # UI preview diagram ├── skills/ │ └── conversation-timeline/ │ └── SKILL.md # /conversation-timeline skill & pill launcher └── sidecars/ └── organizer/ ├── sidecar.json # Aux pane Web UI configuration ├── lib.mjs # Cross-platform transcript & URI parsers ├── main.mjs # Sidecar HTTP backend & incremental cache ├── index.html # Side panel markup (strict CSP) ├── styles.css # Host theme-token adaptive styles ├── app.js # Folder tree, mini calendar &zh/en i18n └── tests/ └── organizer.test.mjs # Node.js built-in test suite ``` ## Development / 本地开发与测试 ```bash cd sidecars/organizer npm test ``` ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © [Wriquet](https://github.com/Wriquet)
